h1: Land Rover Engine Matching by Registration & VIN
lede: Identify the correct engine for your Land Rover using VIN and registration data — precise matching for rebuilds, replacements, and supply & fit.

blocks.html: Engine matching is the process of identifying the exact engine specification for a specific Land Rover vehicle using the VIN (Vehicle Identification Number) and registration details. At our workshop, we follow a professional, data-driven approach to ensure every rebuild, replacement, or supply-and-fit job uses the correct engine.

items: **VIN Decoding:** The 17-character VIN reveals model year, manufacturing plant, engine family, body style, transmission, and market specification. We decode it using Land Rover's official TOPIx system.
**Engine Number Lookup:** We cross-reference the engine number from your V5 with dealer records and parts catalogues to confirm the exact engine code.
**Cross-Referencing:** Using JLR SDD / Pathfinder diagnostic tools, we confirm power output (kW/PS), emission standard (Euro 5/6), and ancillary fitment points for the specific application.
**ECU Programming:** If an ECU has been replaced, we reprogramme it with the correct VIN to ensure full diagnostic communication and compatibility.

blocks.html: Whether your Land Rover is a classic Defender Td5, a modern Ingenium-powered Discovery, or a supercharged SVR, we match the right engine every time.

steps.title: Locate VIN & Engine Number
steps.body: We identify the VIN from the windscreen plate and the engine number from the V5 or engine block.

steps.title: Decode VIN via TOPIx
steps.body: We input the VIN into Land Rover's official TOPIx parts and service system to retrieve the full vehicle specification.

steps.title: Confirm Engine Code & Power Output
steps.body: The system returns the exact engine code, power output (kW/PS), and emission standard.

steps.title: Verify Emission Standard & Ancillaries
steps.body: We check Euro 5/6 compliance and confirm ancillary fitment (alternator, power steering pump, A/C) for your specific model.

steps.title: Cross-Reference Parts Catalogue
steps.body: We ensure all part numbers match the correct engine variant and application.

steps.title: Provide Matching Report
steps.body: You receive a detailed report confirming the exact engine required for your vehicle.

items.a: Engine matching ensures that your replacement or rebuilt engine is exactly the right specification for your vehicle, including power output, emission standards, and ancillary fitment. Incorrect matching can cause drivability issues and ECU incompatibility.

items.q: Can you match an engine using just the registration?
items.a: Yes, we can start the process with your registration number, but the VIN provides the most detailed and accurate information. We always verify using the VIN to ensure complete accuracy.

items.q: What if my Land Rover's VIN is not in the system?
items.a: For older vehicles (pre-2000), dealer records may be incomplete. In such cases, we use physical engine number inspection and cross-reference with parts catalogues to determine the correct engine.

items.q: Do you match engines for classic Land Rovers?
items.a: Absolutely. We match engines for classic models like the Defender Td5, 300Tdi, and even earlier Series-based vehicles, using a combination of VIN and physical inspection.

items.q: Is engine matching included in your rebuild service?
items.a: Yes, engine matching is a standard part of our rebuild, replacement, and supply-and-fit services. You don't pay extra for the matching process.
